slice: Lead integration of H6b channel bridge and H2c core event tools into Runtime and the Worker
purpose: Land the two verified integration diffs: install the channel invalidation sink in the Worker, add the channel projection to runtime.snapshot, construct the trusted per-Goal core event tool factory and pass it to LocalCoreOptions, expose the owner-only zero-model core event tool probe command plus its diagnostic tool, and keep existing H1 zero-tool fallback when no factory is configured.

baseline.head: 26bda0e
baseline.note: H0..H6b/H2c and evidence refresh committed; 1375 baseline tests

changes.worker: ConversationDomain creation now installs ingress.setInvalidationSink(...) and forwards channelRef/reasonRef/sourceWatermark to bridgeChannelInvalidation in the same transaction; reference is backfilled for the table when the binding appears.
changes.runtime: constructs ChannelRuntimeBridge after ControlStore.open; adds channels to snapshot (read-only, body-free projection); creates a trusted per-Goal CoreDecisionEventToolFactory after EventService and passes eventTools into LocalCoreOptions (no factory => historical H1 zero-tool path); adds runtime.probe-core-event-tools with session.probe admission semantics and diagnostics.coreEventToolProbe; the worker probe command from H2a remains.
changes.index: exports and registers shiyu_diagnose_core_event_tools (parameterless, non-concurrency-safe) which executes exactly runtime.probe-core-event-tools; the status/worker diagnostics tool definitions remain exported for tests.
changes.tests: channel-bridge-worker tests adapted to the now-integrated in-transaction sink (pull bridge remains covered via a channel bound after invalidation; projection pending semantics documented); host-diagnostics-tool tests add the core diagnostic command contract.

leadIsolatedIntegrationCheck.tool: scripts/slice-verify.mjs (isolated worktree at HEAD 26bda0e + only these 5 files; node_modules + pinned Python symlinked)

verification.targeted: 145/145 across runtime, host-status (lossless snapshot with the new channels key), host diagnostics, channel bridge (host+worker), core event tools, core plan/local-core, events worker mount/paths; 0 fail/0 skip.
verification.note: The slice check is a full npm run check in an isolated worktree; the shared tree full check is not used because other slices may be in progress.

knownLimitations: ChannelRuntimeProjection.pending.unapplied uses the global minimum applied watermark, so with multiple bindings at different watermarks it can over-report; per-binding idempotency is enforced by bridgePending. Documented for a future projection refinement.
No fixed-host validation of the new channels projection or core probe yet (next step after this commit).
No real platform/channel, model, embedding or Lab action; the core probe only proves mounting, not real model tool invocation or plan quality.
evidenceLevel: G1 integration + full isolated check; fixed-host validation pending.
